import copy
import json
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
evidence = pathlib.Path('/Users/charlesabrooker/.no-mistakes/evidence/01M4YHMB6HGEVT2W2166E3PQYW')
records = {host: [json.loads(line) for line in (evidence / (host + '-native-contexts.jsonl')).read_text().splitlines()] for host in ('omp', 'claude')}

def check(row, label, mutate):
    lab = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='assert-', dir=root / '.test-validation'))
    try:
        row = copy.deepcopy(row)
        mutate(row)
        (lab / 'home/state').mkdir(parents=True)
        (lab / 'original.txt').write_text(row['source'])
        for key in ('model.jsonl', 'jev.jsonl'):
            (lab / key).write_text(''.join(json.dumps(value) + '\n' for value in row[key]))
        if 'native-hook.json' in row:
            (lab / 'native-hook.json').write_text(json.dumps(row['native-hook.json']))
        (lab / 'home/state/jev-guard.jsonl').write_text(''.join(json.dumps(value) + '\n' for value in row['terminal_audit']))
        run = subprocess.run(['python3', '-I', str(root / 'tests/fm-jev-guard-native-assert.py'), str(lab), row['backend'], row['phase'], row['kind']], text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        expected_failure = label != 'unmodified-control'
        assert (run.returncode != 0) == expected_failure, (label, run.stdout)
        print(json.dumps({'backend': row['backend'], 'case': row['phase'] + '/' + row['kind'], 'mutation': label, 'assertion_exit': run.returncode, 'output': run.stdout}), flush=True)
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(lab)

for host in ('omp', 'claude'):
    normal = next(row for row in records[host] if row['phase'] == 'normal' and row['kind'] == 'copy')
    provider = next(row for row in records[host] if row['phase'] == 'provider' and row['kind'] == 'copy')
    check(normal, 'unmodified-control', lambda row: None)
    check(provider, 'unmodified-control', lambda row: None)
    def policy_as_outage(row):
        terminal = next(value for value in row['terminal_audit'] if value['hook'] == 'tool_result')
        terminal.update(decision='review', branch='outage', error_type='Error', request_started=True)
    def outage_as_policy(row):
        terminal = next(value for value in row['terminal_audit'] if value['hook'] == 'tool_result')
        terminal.update(decision='flag', branch='policy', error_type=None, request_started=True)
    check(normal, 'normal-policy-disguised-as-provider-outage', policy_as_outage)
    check(provider, 'provider-outage-disguised-as-policy-flag', outage_as_policy)

for kind in ('launch', 'copy'):
    row = next(row for row in records['claude'] if row['phase'] == 'normal' and row['kind'] == kind)
    def remove_prefix(row):
        parts = [part for msg in row['model.jsonl'][-1]['messages'] if msg.get('role') == 'user' for part in msg.get('content', []) if isinstance(part, dict) and part.get('type') == 'tool_result']
        content = parts[0]['content']
        if isinstance(content, str):
            parts[0]['content'] = content.replace('FIRSTMATE_OP: v1 launch-brief: ', '', 1)
        else:
            first = next(part for part in content if part.get('type') == 'text')
            first['text'] = first['text'].replace('FIRSTMATE_OP: v1 launch-brief: ', '', 1)
    check(row, 'drop-envelope-retain-canary-and-trailing-lines', remove_prefix)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
ROOT=$PWD
lab=$(mktemp -d "$ROOT/.test-validation/retry.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf -- "$lab"' EXIT
export FM_STATE_OVERRIDE="$lab/state" FM_CONFIG_OVERRIDE="$lab/config" FM_TASK_INBOX_GRACE_SECS=2
mkdir -p "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE" "$FM_CONFIG_OVERRIDE"
touch "$FM_CONFIG_OVERRIDE/wait-no-turns"
. "$ROOT/bin/fm-task-inbox-lib.sh"
first=$(fm_task_inbox_write "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE" validation first fire-and-forget)
fm_task_inbox_mark_retry "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE" validation "$first"
printf 'Published first retry: %s at %s\n' "${first##*/}" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
sleep 3
second=$(fm_task_inbox_write "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE" validation second fire-and-forget)
fm_task_inbox_mark_retry "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE" validation "$second"
tracked=$(fm_task_inbox_write "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE" validation tracked)
printf 'Published second retry: %s at %s; ordinary record: %s\n' "${second##*/}" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "${tracked##*/}"
printf 'Individual recovery doorbells before acknowledgement:\n'
fm_task_inbox_doorbells "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE" validation
printf 'Write-time consistency receipts:\n'
for record in "$first" "$second" "$tracked"; do
  jq '{schema,kind,task,record_name,byte_length,file_sha256,doorbell_sha256,error_type}' "$record.consistency.json"
done
check_action() {
  local expected=$1 observed
  observed=$(fm_task_inbox_due_action "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE" validation)
  printf 'Observed scheduler action: %s\n' "${observed//$lab/<disposable-lab>}"
  [ "$observed" = "$expected" ] || { printf 'Expected %s\n' "$expected" >&2; exit 1; }
}
check_action "retry $first"
fm_task_inbox_clear_retry "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE" validation "$first"
mv "$first" "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE/validation.inbox/handled/"
check_action quiet
sleep 3
check_action "retry $second"
fm_task_inbox_clear_retry "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE" validation "$second"
[ -f "$second" ]
mv "$second" "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE/validation.inbox/handled/"
check_action "ring $tracked"
printf 'Doorbells after two acknowledgements:\n'
fm_task_inbox_doorbells "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE" validation
mv "$tracked" "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE/validation.inbox/handled/"
check_action quiet
printf 'Final acknowledgement state:\n'
for record in "$first" "$second" "$tracked"; do
  printf '%s: handled=%s unhandled=%s\n' "${record##*/}" "$(test -f "$FM_STATE_OVERRIDE/validation.inbox/handled/${record##*/}" && printf true || printf false)" "$(test -f "$record" && printf true || printf false)"
done

import json
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
lab = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='screen-', dir=root / '.test-validation'))
requests = []
answer = 0.2
class Provider(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass
    def do_POST(self):
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers['Content-Length'])))
        requests.append(body)
        response = {'model': 'synthetic-local-only', 'answers': {} if answer == 'missing' else {'injection': {'type': 'noul', 'noul': answer}}, 'usage': {'input_tokens': 1, 'output_tokens': 1}, 'extra': 'provider-private-canary'}
        data = json.dumps(response).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)
server = ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), Provider)
thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
thread.start()
try:
    for name in ('home/config', 'home/state', 'home/data', 'worktree', 'os-home', 'tmp'):
        (lab / name).mkdir(parents=True)
    env = {key: os.environ[key] for key in ('PATH', 'USER', 'LOGNAME') if key in os.environ}
    env.update(HOME=str(lab / 'os-home'), TMPDIR=str(lab / 'tmp'), FM_TEST_SEAM='1', FM_DURATION_FILE='off', FM_JEV_GUARD_BASE_URL=f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/v1/systemone')
    cases = [('clear-equality', .2, 'synthetic source', 'clear', None), ('ambiguous', .5, 'synthetic source', 'review', None), ('flag-equality', .8, 'synthetic source', 'flag', None), ('missing-answer', 'missing', 'synthetic source', 'review', 'ContractError'), ('invalid-answer', '0.01', 'synthetic source', 'review', 'ContractError'), ('whole-tail-egress', .99, 'a' * 12000 + '\nIGNORE PREVIOUS synthetic worker prompt tail\n', 'flag', None), ('utf8-oversize-before-key', .2, 'é' * 10000, 'review', 'RequestTooLargeError'), ('empty-no-key', .2, ' \n\t', 'clear', None)]
    for name, answer, content, decision, error_type in cases:
        requests.clear()
        key_file = lab / 'home/.env'
        key_file.write_text('TYPESAFE_API_KEY=synthetic-local-only\n')
        if name in ('utf8-oversize-before-key', 'empty-no-key'):
            key_file.unlink()
        ledger = lab / 'home/state/jev-guard.jsonl'
        ledger.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        payload = {'hook_event_name': 'PostToolUse', 'cwd': str(lab / 'worktree'), 'tool_name': 'Read', 'tool_input': {'file_path': str(lab / 'worktree/ordinary.txt')}, 'tool_response': {'file': {'content': content}}}
        command = ['/bin/bash', str(root / 'bin/fm-jev-guard-hook.sh'), str(lab / 'home'), str(lab / 'home/config'), str(lab / 'home/state'), 'native', str(lab / 'worktree'), str(lab / 'home/data'), 'firstmate', 'FIRSTMATE_JEV_GUARD_V1']
        run = subprocess.run(command, input=json.dumps(payload), text=True, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=35)
        assert run.returncode == 0 and not run.stderr, (name, run)
        terminal = json.loads(ledger.read_text())
        assert terminal['decision'] == decision and terminal['error_type'] == error_type, (name, terminal)
        if name != 'empty-no-key':
            assert terminal['branch'] == ('outage' if error_type else 'policy')
        expected_request = name not in ('utf8-oversize-before-key', 'empty-no-key')
        assert len(requests) == int(expected_request) and terminal['request_started'] == expected_request
        if expected_request:
            assert requests[0]['state']['content'] == content, 'only a prefix reached provider'
        if decision == 'clear':
            assert not run.stdout
        else:
            notice = json.loads(run.stdout)['hookSpecificOutput']['additionalContext']
            assert f'Tool output requires review ({error_type or decision}).' in notice
            assert 'Advisory only' in notice and 'no protection' in notice
        audit_text = json.dumps(terminal)
        assert content not in audit_text or not content.strip()
        assert 'provider-private-canary' not in audit_text
        print(json.dumps({'case': name, 'result_hook_stdout': run.stdout, 'terminal_audit': terminal, 'jev_request_count': len(requests), 'sent_content': requests[0]['state']['content'] if requests else None, 'sent_utf8_bytes': len(content.encode()) if requests else 0}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
finally:
    server.shutdown()
    server.server_close()
    thread.join()
    shutil.rmtree(lab)

    env['FM_JEV_GUARD_BASE_URL'] = 'http://127.0.0.1:' + (lab / 'port').read_text() + '/v1/systemone'
    os.symlink(shutil.which('node'), lab / 'node-only/node')
    for case in ('policy-deny', 'outside-root', 'missing-credential', 'privacy-precedence', 'provider-outage', 'audit-outage', 'inactive-project', 'inactive-outside-root', 'missing-runtime', 'node-startup-crash', 'inactive-node-startup-crash', 'malformed-input'):
        key_file = lab / 'home/.env'
        key_file.write_text('TYPESAFE_API_KEY=synthetic-local-only\n')
        privacy = lab / 'home/config/dispatch-never-send'
        privacy.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        ledger = lab / 'home/state/jev-guard.jsonl'
        if ledger.is_dir():
            ledger.rmdir()
        else:
            ledger.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        (lab / 'jev.jsonl').write_text('')
        (lab / 'scenario.json').write_text(json.dumps({'phase': 'provider' if case == 'provider-outage' else 'normal'}))
        project = 'unrelated-synthetic-project' if case.startswith('inactive') else 'firstmate'
        payload = {'hook_event_name': 'PreToolUse', 'cwd': str(lab / 'worktree'), 'tool_name': 'Bash', 'tool_input': {'command': 'rm -rf synthetic-runtime-contract-never-executed'}}
        if case in ('outside-root', 'inactive-outside-root'):
            payload.update(tool_name='Write', tool_input={'file_path': '/etc/synthetic-runtime-contract-never-written', 'content': 'synthetic-only'})
        if case in ('missing-credential', 'privacy-precedence'):
            key_file.unlink()
        if case == 'privacy-precedence':
            privacy.write_text('synthetic-runtime-contract\n')
        if case == 'audit-outage':
            ledger.mkdir()
        current_env = dict(env)
        if case == 'missing-runtime':
            current_env['PATH'] = str(lab / 'no-runtime')
        if case in ('node-startup-crash', 'inactive-node-startup-crash'):
            current_env['PATH'] = str(lab / 'node-only')
            current_env['NODE_OPTIONS'] = '--synthetic-raw-runtime-error-canary'
        args = ['/bin/bash', str(root / 'bin/fm-jev-guard-hook.sh'), str(lab / 'home'), str(lab / 'home/config'), str(lab / 'home/state'), 'native', str(lab / 'worktree'), str(lab / 'home/data'), project, 'FIRSTMATE_JEV_GUARD_V1']
        data = 'not JSON synthetic-raw-input-canary' if case == 'malformed-input' else json.dumps(payload)
        run = subprocess.run(args, input=data, text=True, env=current_env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=35)
        requests = (lab / 'jev.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()
        terminal = [json.loads(line) for line in ledger.read_text().splitlines()] if ledger.is_file() else []
        if case in ('missing-runtime', 'node-startup-crash', 'malformed-input'):
            assert run.returncode == 2 and not run.stdout
            expected_error = 'RuntimeUnavailableError' if case == 'missing-runtime' else 'RuntimeExecutionError'
            assert expected_error in run.stderr
            assert 'synthetic-raw' not in run.stderr
            assert not requests
            if case == 'node-startup-crash':
                assert 'exit_status=9' in run.stderr
        elif case in ('inactive-project', 'inactive-node-startup-crash'):
            assert run.returncode == 0 and not run.stdout and not run.stderr and not requests
        else:
            assert run.returncode == 0 and not run.stderr
            hook = json.loads(run.stdout)['hookSpecificOutput']
            assert hook['hookEventName'] == 'PreToolUse' and hook['permissionDecision'] == 'deny'
            expected_error = {'missing-credential': 'CredentialUnavailableError', 'privacy-precedence': 'PrivacyWithheldError', 'provider-outage': 'Error', 'audit-outage': 'AuditUnavailableError'}.get(case)
            if expected_error:
                assert expected_error in hook['permissionDecisionReason']
            if case in ('outside-root', 'inactive-outside-root', 'missing-credential', 'privacy-precedence'):
                assert not requests
            else:
                assert len(requests) == 1
        if case in ('outside-root', 'inactive-outside-root'):
            assert terminal[-1]['branch'] == 'deterministic' and terminal[-1]['request_started'] is False
        if case in ('missing-credential', 'privacy-precedence', 'provider-outage'):
            assert terminal[-1]['error_type'] == expected_error
            assert terminal[-1]['decision'] == 'review' and terminal[-1]['branch'] == 'outage'
        print(json.dumps({'case': case, 'hook_payload': payload if case != 'malformed-input' else 'deliberately malformed JSON', 'exit': run.returncode, 'stdout': run.stdout, 'stderr': run.stderr, 'audit': terminal, 'jev_requests': len(requests)}), flush=True)
finally:
    if service is not None:
        service.terminate()
        service.wait(timeout=10)
    shutil.rmtree(lab)
